summary: Meta Platforms filed a Rule 424(b)(5) prospectus supplement for a $15.0 billion five-tranche senior unsecured note offering: $3.25B 5.850% due 2031, $3.25B 6.250% due 2033, $4.0B 6.550% due 2036, $1.75B 7.350% due 2046, and $2.75B 7.500% due 2056. Public offering prices range from 99.629% to 99.998%, with underwriting discounts of 0.120%-0.400%, netting roughly $14.95 billion before expenses. Interest pays semi-annually from May 15, 2027; notes are unsecured, pari passu, redeemable, unlisted, and DTC book-entry, settling November 5, 2026. Citigroup and Morgan Stanley lead. This is a routine investment-grade debt takedown, not a special situation.
